BOARD-2 is implemented and verified.

## Outcome

Mounted the lazy PixiJS case-board route for `BOARD-FR-01`, `BOARD-FR-07`, `BOARD-CON-02`, `BOARD-CON-03`, and `FND-CON-01`.

- `CaseBoardPage` loads the case and cards, builds a plain `BoardSnapshot`, mounts `BoardCanvas` lazily, restores the stored camera, and debounces viewport writes by 500 ms.
- The canvas renders a procedural cork background and card containers, with pointer drag pan, two-pointer pinch zoom, wheel/trackpad pointer-anchored zoom, and DOM zoom/reset controls.
- `usePixiApp` owns renderer setup, resize, single-canvas mounting, context-loss recovery, and full teardown of ticker, textures, listeners, app, and canvas.
- `BoardScene` emits no writes and reads only the snapshot; it culls cards outside the viewport plus a 200 px screen-space margin.
- `textureCache` enforces a 200-resident cap and releases offscreen entries.

## Files created or changed

Created:
- `src/board/BoardCanvas.tsx`
- `src/board/BoardCanvas.css`
- `src/board/BoardScene.ts`
- `src/board/usePixiApp.ts`
- `src/board/boardInput.ts`
- `src/board/textureCache.ts`
- `src/features/case/CaseBoardPage.tsx`
- `src/features/case/CaseBoardPage.css`
- `tests/board/BoardCanvas.test.tsx`
- `tests/board/textureCache.test.ts`
- `e2e/board.spec.ts`

Changed:
- `src/app/routes.tsx` — replaces the case placeholder with the lazy `CaseBoardPage`; adds `boardRepository` / `loadBoardRepository` injection.

Not changed:
- `src/data/caseRepository.ts` — the existing `CaseRepositoryPort.saveViewport` contract already covers this task, and repository edits are outside the task constraints.

## Evidence

Viewport and gestures:
- A synthetic 120 px / 80 px background drag changed the rendered camera and persisted the final position after the debounce.
- Wheel zoom stayed pointer-anchored and clamped at `2.5` and `0.25`; pinch math is covered in the unit test.
- Reset applied `{ x: 0, y: 0, scale: 1 }` as a temporary camera; the stored viewport remained unchanged after 900 ms.
- A subsequent pan persisted; reload restored the saved camera within test tolerance.
- Two route-away/back cycles left exactly one canvas and no console errors.

Context loss:
- `WEBGL_lose_context` produced the recoverable fallback on desktop, tablet, and phone; “Restore board” recreated the renderer and returned to `ready`.

Bundle boundary:
- Initial shell entry: `index-BVWFUYgW.js` at 84.60 kB gzip, 0 pixi references; `rolldown-runtime` also 0.
- Separate board chunk: `BoardCanvas-FaLLyXnd.js` at 92.62 kB gzip, pixi references present.
- `CaseBoardPage-DKZOZL-J.js` at 3.01 kB gzip, no pixi; the page chunk is separate from the canvas chunk.

Validation:
- `npm test -- tests/board/BoardCanvas.test.tsx` — 8 tests passed.
- `npm run test:e2e -- e2e/board.spec.ts` — 6 tests passed across desktop, tablet-landscape, and phone.
- `npm run build` — passed.
- Full `npm test` — 505 tests across 35 files passed.
- `npm run lint`, `npm run typecheck`, and `npm run format:check` — passed.

Shared-contract note: `CaseBoardPage.tsx` and `routes.tsx` are shared with `ui-engineer`, `foundation-engineer`, and later BOARD-3/4/5 work. Preserve the lazy `BoardCanvas` import, the 500 ms serialized viewport debounce, and the temporary reset semantics.
